_comment: The docs site's interface strings. Written with keys in part 4 so that no file would be retrofitted later, and decision 5 put the Chinese in phase 14 — part 6a revised that by arithmetic on 3 September 2026: 175 of these 242 keys were already the portal's own strings, so only 67 were this site's to write and zh.json landed here instead. These are the chrome only. Everything a reader comes here to read is a markdown page in content/ or api/_content/, and no page string ever appears in this file.
shell.title: Careers@GFTV documentation
shell.description: Guides to the Careers@GFTV job portal and its Telegram bot.
search.label: Search the guides
search.failed: Search could not load. Reload the page in a moment.
search.staffFailed: The staff guides could not be searched this time.
account.signOutFailed: That did not go through. Try again.
page.notFoundBody: The address may be wrong, or the page may be one your account cannot open. If you are staff, sign in and try again.
page.errorBody: Something went wrong at our end. Reload the page in a moment.
page.offline: You are offline, so this page could not be fetched.
codes.backupIntro: Ten codes, each usable once, for getting past the second step of signing in when you cannot reach Telegram. They never set a password.
codes.confirmSaved: I have saved these somewhere safe.
codes.copyManually: Your browser would not let us copy. The codes are selected, so copy them yourself.
codes.fileFooter: Keep this file somewhere only you can reach. Anyone holding a recovery code can set a new password on the account.
codes.fileGeneratedOn: Generated on {date}. Each code works once.
codes.noneLeftBackup: None left. Generate a set before you need one.
codes.noneLeftRecovery: None left. Without a recovery code, nobody can get you back into this account on their own.
codes.onceWarning: This is the only time these are shown. They cannot be recovered afterwards, only replaced.
codes.recoveryIntro: Ten codes, each usable once. One of these plus nothing else sets a new password on your account, so keep them somewhere only you can reach.
codes.runningLow: Only {count} left. Generate a new set before you run out.
danger.codeHint: Asked for because this account uses a Telegram code at sign in. A trusted device does not skip this one.
danger.codeSending: Asking for a code to be sent.
danger.passwordHint: Checked on our side, not in this browser.
danger.typeUsernameHint: Typed out instead of ticking a box, so this cannot be done by muscle memory. Capitals matter.
error.network: That did not reach us. Check your connection and try again.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong at our end. Try again in a moment.
feature.maintenance: Temporarily unavailable while we fix something.
security.devicesBody: A trusted device skips the second step of signing in for 30 days. It never skips your password, and it never gets past anything in the danger zone.
security.passkeyBody: A passkey is your fingerprint, your face, or a security key, used as the second step of signing in. There is no code to type and nothing to copy, and a passkey cannot be phished: your device will only use it on this site.
security.passkeyFailed: That passkey could not be added. Try again.
security.passkeyUnsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Try a current version of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox.
security.passwordForChanges: Asked for because this changes how signing in works. A session on its own is not enough.
staffAccount.backupBody: These get you past the second step of signing in when you do not have your phone. They never get you past your password.
staffAccount.backupReaches: This is one account. Generating a new set here replaces the backup codes your gftv.asia sign in uses as well.
staffAccount.dangerBody: Each of these takes something away from your account. Every one asks you to read what it does, type your username, and prove who you are.
staffAccount.dangerCodeFromApp: The six digit code your authenticator app is showing now.
staffAccount.dangerConsequence.invalidat: Every backup code you still hold stops working, at the second step of signing in.
Every recovery code you still hold stops working, and you have no self serve way back in until you generate a new set.
staffAccount.dangerConsequence.remove_pa: Every passkey on this account stops working, on both Careers@GFTV sites, and you sign in with your password and a code until you add another.
staffAccount.dangerConsequence.remove_to: Your authenticator app stops working and every trusted device is revoked, because each was trusted on the strength of it.
staffAccount.dangerConsequence.revoke_de: Every browser you trusted answers the second step again, on both Careers@GFTV sites.
staffAccount.dangerConsequence.sign_out_: Every session on both Careers@GFTV sites ends, including this browser, so you sign in again here. Your gftv.asia session is separate and is not affected.
staffAccount.dangerNotNotified: Nobody is notified. This site has no email, so the only record is in the audit log.
staffAccount.dangerReaches: This is one account, so it takes effect at gftv.asia too.
staffAccount.devicesPerSite: Trust itself is still earned per site: trusting this browser here does not skip the second step on the other one.
staffAccount.devicesShared: This is every trusted device on your account, including any trusted on the other Careers@GFTV site. Revoking one here revokes it there.
staffAccount.heading: Account settings
staffAccount.loadFailed: Your account settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
staffAccount.noDelete: There is no delete account here. Your account belongs to gftv.asia and is shared with it, so it is not this site’s to delete.
staffAccount.passkeyScope: A passkey works on both Careers@GFTV sites, this one and the documentation site, because the two share one identity. It does not work at gftv.asia, which is a different domain.
staffAccount.passwordReaches: This is one account. Changing your password here changes it at gftv.asia too, and signs you out of every other browser on both Careers@GFTV sites.
staffAccount.profileElsewhere: Your username, display name and email belong to your gftv.asia account and are changed there.
staffAccount.recoveryBody: These get you past your password if you forget it. There is no email on this site, so they are the only way back into your account without help.
staffAccount.renameHint: Something you will recognise in this list, such as the device it lives on.
staffAccount.sessionsBody: Each site keeps its own sessions, so signing out of one leaves the other signed in. Your gftv.asia sessions are separate again and are not listed here.
staffAccount.sessionsNoDevice: We record which site each session is on and when it started, and nothing about the device it is on, so this list cannot name your laptop or your phone.
staffAccount.sessionsPartial: One of the two sites could not be read, so this list may be missing sessions.
staffAccount.totpBody: An authenticator app shows a six digit code that changes every thirty seconds, used as the second step of signing in.
staffAccount.totpCodeToRemove: Asked for as well as your password, because turning off your second step is what somebody holding a stolen password would want most.
staffAccount.totpConfirmHint: Type the code your app shows now, so we know it stored the right thing.
staffAccount.totpQrLabel: Setup code for your authenticator app
staffAccount.totpReaches: This is one account. Setting up or removing an authenticator app here does the same at gftv.asia.
staffAccount.totpScan: Scan this with your authenticator app.
staffAccount.totpTypeInstead: If you cannot scan it, type this into the app by hand.
staffReset.pageTitle: Reset your staff password | Careers@GFTV documentation
staffReset.heading: Reset your password
staffReset.reaches: This is one account. The password you set here is your gftv.asia password too, so it changes there as well.
staffReset.codeIntro: Type your username and one of your account recovery codes. Each code works once.
staffReset.recoveryCodeHint: One of the codes from your account settings. Not a two step backup code, which is a different set.
staffReset.noCodes: With no recovery codes and no second step, nobody can get you back in from here. Ask at gftv.asia instead.
staffReset.secondFactorIntro: One more step for {username}, so a recovery code on its own is not enough.
staffReset.codeOrBackup: Your six digit code, or a backup code
staffReset.doneBody: Every session and every trusted device on this account has ended, so sign in again with your second step.
staffReset.codesLow: Only {count} recovery codes left. Generate a new set from your account settings once you are back in.
login.heading: Sign in
login.intro: The staff guides need a Careers@GFTV staff account, the same one you use on the jobs portal.
login.staySignedIn: Stay signed in for 30 days on this device
login.secondFactorIntro: Prove it is you, the same way you do on the jobs portal.
login.codeOrBackup: Your six digit code, or a backup code
login.trustDeviceThisSite: This skips the second step on this site only. Trusting a browser here does not trust it on the jobs portal.
login.trustDeviceShared: Do not tick it on a shared or public computer.
staffAccount.held: This is built and is switched off until it has been checked once against a real account, because it changes your gftv.asia account too. Everything else on this page works.
staffAccount.dangerLastFactor: This is the last second step on your account, so signing in will be your password alone until you add another.
